release_notes: MBT POS v3.0.74 Stability Follow-up: preserves legitimate rapid taps across different product controls while still blocking a faulty touchscreen repeatedly firing the same control, replays deferred expiry notices once a sale becomes idle, and never silently auto-answers repeated confirmation dialogs. Stock adjustment now locks before confirmation/PIN, handles an empty refreshed catalog correctly, refreshes stale web quantities in-place instead of 409-looping, and hides the web Stock action from non-Super-Admins. Tamper alerts are emitted once, and installer certification now fails immediately and accurately when Windows UAC is cancelled.
